events.title: Subsidy removed, prices double
events.body: The government ends the petrol subsidy with immediate effect. Pump prices roughly double overnight, and transport fares rise with them.

events.title: Occupy Nigeria and a general strike
events.body: Labour unions call a general strike and nationwide demonstrations begin, shutting down commercial activity in Lagos, Abuja and Kano for several days.

events.title: Subsidy partially restored
events.body: President Goodluck Jonathan announces a partial restoration, cutting the pump price back from its post-removal level and ending the strike.

events.title: "Subsidy is gone"
events.body: President Bola Tinubu declares in his inaugural address that the fuel subsidy has ended. Queues form at filling stations within hours and prices rise sharply over the following weeks.
